SP Requirement: Accelerator (A) cannot receive data from Router (R) which originates while the sSocket is actively being reset.
Accelerator (A) cannot send data to Router (R) which originates while the sSocket is actively being reset.
Accelerator (A) receives the default values while the sSocket is actively being reset.
The sSocket outputs the default values to Router (R) while the sSocket is actively being reset.
The configuration/registers are cleared and set to contain the default values while the sSocket is actively being reset.
The TE can read from but not write to anomaly registers.
Accelerator (A) cannot receive data from Router (R) which originates while the sSocket is in reset mode.
Accelerator (A) cannot send data to Router (R) which originates while the sSocket is in reset mode.
Accelerator (A) receives the default values while the sSocket is in reset mode.
The sSocket outputs the default values to Router (R) while the sSocket is in reset mode.
The configuration/anomaly registers contain the default values until they are modified by the TE (config.) and/or sSocket (illegal req. metadata tracking).
Accelerator (A) cannot receive data associated with an illegal address from Router (R) which originates while the sSocket is in supervising mode.
Accelerator (A) cannot send data associated with an illegal address to Router (R) which originates while the sSocket is in supervising mode.
Accelerator (A) cannot receive data from Router (R) which originates while the sSocket is in decouple mode.
Accelerator (A) cannot send data to Router (R) which originates while the sSocket is in decouple mode.
Accelerator (A) receives the default values while the sSocket is in decouple mode.
The sSocket outputs the default values to the Router (R) while the sSocket is in decouple mode.
The anomaly registers are updated with illegal request metadata after the sSocket detects an illegal request.
An interrupt to TE is generated after the sSocket detects an illegal request.
Any Accelerator (A) cannot receive data from any region not contained within its sSocket’s ACP.
Any Accelerator (A) cannot send data to any region not contained within its sSocket’s ACP.
